Proposition
[Local convexity and deformation stability] 1. Proposition 8.3.3\group convex hyperbolic manifoldsSource: thurston:page-0192, thurston:page-0193, thurston:page-0194 Local convexity implies convexity. Every sufficiently small deformation of a compact convex hyperbolic manifold can be enlarged slightly to a convex hyperbolic manifold homeomorphic to it. The same holds for uniformly convex noncompact manifolds under uniformly small deformations.
Proof

\sketch Subdivide paths into uniformly short pieces and straighten adjacent pieces; strict convex enlargement supplies a uniform interior buffer. For a deformation, take convex hulls in uniformly sized balls; their union remains locally convex and hence convex.

□
